verdict.rationale: Semgrep's OpenAPI-driven API reference has a live "Try it" playground on each endpoint page, with generated cURL examples and an in-page runner. It is backed by a downloadable OpenAPI 3.0.3 spec covering the /api/v1 endpoints. The probe that 404'd on docs-domain OpenAPI paths does not contradict this, because the spec is served from semgrep.dev/api/v1. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration that the runner works, and evidence of runnable examples beyond the single cited findings endpoint.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can explore an interactive API reference with runnable examples
